KYB coil-spring fork, 310 mm (12.2 in) travel, Yamaha Suspension Oil S1, 501.0 cm³ (16.94 US oz, 17.67 Imp.oz) per leg; standard clickers (counted out from fully in): rebound 8 of 20, compression 12 of 20.

KYB link shock, 317 mm (12.5 in) wheel travel; standard settings: spring preload 8.0 mm (0.31 in) turned in from free length, rebound 12 clicks out (of 30), high-speed compression 1-1/8 turns out, low-speed compression 9 clicks out.

Standard spring rates are 4.6 N/mm (fork) and 56 N/mm (shock); Yamaha lists optional fork springs from 4.1-5.1 N/mm. Rear sag is set to a sunken (rider-on) length of 90-100 mm before any other tuning.

records.statement: The 2020 YZ125 is carbureted with a Mikuni TMXx38SS, not fuel injected.
